description: Native fruit tree with three-part leaves and hanging clusters of red fruit. If you plant one thing for frugivorous birds, this is the strongest candidate.
nativeStatus: Native to the Río de la Plata region
ecology: A understorey and edge tree of riverside and talar woodland. Fruits in high summer, when many birds are feeding young.
wildlifeNotes: The red fruit is among the most sought after by frugivorous birds in the region, and the small flowers draw pollinators before it.
size: Altura / height: 4-8 m. Porte: árbol frutal pequeño, persistente o semipersistente.
edibleUses: The small red fruits are sweet and edible fresh.
